264|b3b21323.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
264|b3b21323.text: At ease, $C.  If you are just passing though I suggest you stick to the roads and only travel by day. If your business is here in Darkshire, consider lending your abilities to The Night Watch.  Our skill is unquestionable but our numbers are small.

101-progress.name: Madame Eva
101-progress.text: Bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom.  For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.
101-progress.title: The Totem of Infliction

1241-progress.name: Jorgen
1241-progress.text: Hmph, you better have good reason to interrupt a man and his fishin'. I don't take kindly to peddlers, let alone beggars.
1241-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

1242-progress.name: Elling Trias
1242-progress.text: Hello, $N. Is there something I can do for you? Perhaps you'd like to try some of our special Trias cheddar? Or a block of Darnassian bleu?
1242-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

1243-progress.name: Watcher Backus
1243-progress.text:
Not too safe to be traveling about in the woods, $N. Be careful, and if you see anything suspicious or dangerous, contact the Watchers immediately. Don't try and take anything on yourself. We're not responsible for anything terrible that might happen to you.

But we both know you're gonna ignore me and fight whatever comes out of the darkness anyway, don't we? Haha, yeah, you adventurer types... all the same.
1243-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

149-progress.name: Blind Mary
149-progress.text:
<Sob> Oh please, don't look at me!  I tore out these eyes with my own hands, but I can still feel your gaze!

I'm hideous!  Hideous!  Please, look away!!
149-progress.title: Ghost Hair Thread

154-progress.name: Madame Eva
154-progress.text: I sense that you have seen Blind Mary.  You have my Comb...?
154-progress.title: Return the Comb

157-progress.name: Abercrombie
157-progress.text: I need to string the Ghost Hair Thread along my door and my windows to keep out unwanted spirits.  Did you get it for me?
157-progress.title: Deliver the Thread

164-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
164-progress.text: You look a sturdy type, $c. Have you come to join our fight?
164-progress.title: Deliveries to Sven

223-progress.name: Jonathan Carevin
223-progress.text: Yes, what is it? Make it quick, I've pressing matters to attend to.
223-progress.title: Worgen in the Woods

228-progress.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
228-progress.text: I don't blame you if you're having trouble with him, $N. Some of our strongest Watchers have been lost to Mor'Ladim.
228-progress.title: Mor'Ladim

230-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
230-progress.text: You found what??  Please, let me see it...
230-progress.title: Sven's Camp

231-complete.name: A Weathered Grave
231-complete.text:
<A ghostly voice sounds on the wind...>

This is...? Sarah? Could it be she's still alive? The weight is removed from my shoulders...

$N. Take my sword, Archeus. As my soul is put to rest, I have no more need for it. It was forged to do good, and though I have proved myself unworthy to hold it, perhaps you will carry on the Light through it. And keep the ring. I am no longer worthy of it.

Lys, my love...
231-complete.title: A Daughter's Love

240-progress.name: Jitters
240-progress.text: $N, you're here!  Do you have my food?!?
240-progress.title: Return to Jitters

337-progress.name: Milton Sheaf
337-progress.text: Ooh!  What's that old book you have there?  Can I see it??
337-progress.title: An Old History Book

70-progress.name: Caretaker Folsom
70-progress.text: What have ya got there?  Let me take a look at that. . .
70-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

74-progress.name: Marshal Haggard
74-progress.text: What have you got there?  I cannot see.  My eyesight is very bad.  Put it in my hands.
74-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

75-progress.name: Marshal Haggard
75-progress.text: Did you find that page I mentioned, $N?
75-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

78-progress.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
78-progress.text:
Marshal Haggard sent you?  Why didn't you say so? 

Ah, good ol' Haggard.  Poor chap is going to be completely blind before long.  Anyway, let me see what you've got there.
78-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

79-progress.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
79-progress.text: This better be good, $c.  Let me see what you have and tell me your tale.  But by the Light, be quick about it.  Darkshire's defense is my number one priority.  I have not the time to squander on dead-end leads.
79-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

79362-accept.name: Unknown
79362-accept.text:
A shield left behind by the specter of Grant Valor, father of the Valor family and hero of Raven Hill.

With Grant's spirit still battling the undead, perhaps his unfinished business was to slay the scourge that injured him in the Raven Hill Cemetery. It is likely the one his mace is still imbedded in.
79362-accept.title: Grant's Shield

79362-complete.name: Sirra Von'Indi
79362-complete.text:
For a man as proud as Grant Valor to be brought low by such a simple creature says less about him and more about the horrors of battle. It only takes one slip to be crippled for life.

These weapons tell a great deal about their owner. Let me take some time to study them.
79362-complete.title: Grant's Shield

80-progress.name: Clerk Daltry
80-progress.text: Back again, $N?  What do you have this time?
80-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

90-progress.name: Chef Grual
90-progress.text: Were you able to find 10 Lean Wolf Flanks yet?
90-progress.title: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs

93-progress.name: Chef Grual
93-progress.text: Hail, $N.  Did you get those Gooey Spider Legs yet?
93-progress.title: Dusky Crab Cakes

96139-progress.name: Sirra Von'Indi
96139-progress.text: Have you found anything? I'm not holding out much hope.
96139-progress.title: The Valor Family
